name: Bakery & Pastry
description: Comprehensive menu template for pure production-and-display artisan bakeries and patisseries. Designed specifically for bakeries where goods are baked fresh on-site or assembled in-house, showcased in display cases, and sold for takeaway or light counter service without full kitchen cooking or table service.

sections.name: Daily Breads & Loaves
sections.description: Artisan sourdoughs, crusty hearth breads, traditional baguettes, sandwich loaves, and dinner rolls baked fresh in morning cycles. This core section represents the foundation of an artisan bakery, accommodating customer requests for custom slicing thickness and loaf portions.

subSections.name: Artisan Sourdoughs & Country Loaves
subSections.description: Naturally leavened sourdough boules, batards, and country loaves with fermented open crumb and caramelized, blistered crusts.

subSections.name: Baguettes & Batards
subSections.description: Classic French stone-baked baguettes, demi-baguettes, and oval batards with golden crisp crusts and light airy crumb.

subSections.name: Table & Sandwich Breads
subSections.description: Square pullman loaves, tender Japanese milk bread, brioche toast loaves, and enriched sandwich breads ideal for household toasting.

subSections.name: Specialty & Ancient Grains
subSections.description: Nutrient-dense loaves incorporating stoneground heritage grains such as dark rye, spelt, buckwheat, and toasted seed blends.

subSections.name: Rolls & Buns
subSections.description: Portioned dinner rolls, brioche hamburger buns, ciabatta rolls, and soft table rolls for meal accompaniments.

sections.name: Viennoiserie & Morning Pastries
sections.description: Laminated butter pastries, fruit-topped puff pastries, enriched brioches, and morning scones baked fresh before dawn. This high-turnover section drives breakfast and morning coffee foot traffic, offering serving temperature preferences and bulk box discounts for offices and family gatherings.

subSections.name: Laminated Pastries
subSections.description: Classic European butter croissants, pain au chocolat, kouign-amann, and flaky layered puff specialties.

subSections.name: Danishes & Fruit Puff Pastries
subSections.description: Delicate laminated pastries filled with vanilla bean pastry cream, seasonal poached fruits, berries, and glistening glazes.

subSections.name: Brioches & Sweet Breads
subSections.description: Enriched yeasted sweet doughs, Swedish cardamom knots, cinnamon morning buns, and chocolate-swirled babka slices.

subSections.name: Muffins Scones & Quick Breads
subSections.description: Traditional British buttermilk scones, bakery-style fruit muffins, and thick-cut morning tea loaf slices.

choices.label: Warm Up (Gently heated in bakery oven)

timeBehavior.note: Fresh morning viennoiserie is available starting at 07:00 until daily batch sells out.

sections.name: Individual Fine Pastries
sections.description: Artisan single-portion refrigerated patisserie, glossy mirror-glazed entremets, tartlets, choux buns, and French macarons. Designed for refrigerated showcase presentation, afternoon tea, self-indulgence, and gift selections requiring delicate packaging.

subSections.name: Entremets & Glazed Mousse Cakes
subSections.description: Multi-textured individual mousse gateaux featuring fruit inserts, sponge layers, crunchy praline bases, and mirror glazes.

subSections.name: Tartlets & Shortcrust
subSections.description: Crisp sweet pastry tart shells filled with lemon curd, rich chocolate ganache, pastry cream, and fresh seasonal fruit.

subSections.name: Choux Pastry
subSections.description: Airy choux creations, craquelin cream puffs, filled éclairs, and Paris-Brest with diplomat cream and praline.

subSections.name: Layered Pastries & Slices
subSections.description: Classic multi-layered mille-feuille slices, French Opera cake, Russian honey cake, and portioned gateaux cuts.

subSections.name: Macarons & Petit Fours
subSections.description: French almond meringue macarons in assorted seasonal flavors alongside bite-sized petit fours.

choices.label: Luxury Rigid Gift Box with Ribbon

sections.name: Whole & Celebration Cakes
sections.description: Full-size celebration cakes, large tarts, family-sized cheesecakes, and teacakes for milestone celebrations, birthdays, and dinner parties. Supports pre-orders with lead times, serving size selections, custom piped inscriptions, and scheduled pickup coordination.

subSections.name: Ready-to-Go Whole Cakes
subSections.description: Freshly finished whole celebration cakes available immediately in display chillers for same-day walk-in purchases.

subSections.name: Signature Pre-Order Cakes
subSections.description: Custom artisan celebration cakes and layered gateaux requiring 24 to 48 hours advance notice for baking and decorating.

subSections.name: Tarts & Cheesecakes (Family Size)
subSections.description: Large 8 to 10-inch seasonal fruit tarts, Basque burnt cheesecakes, and New York cheesecakes serving 8 to 16 guests.

subSections.name: Tea Cakes & Bundt/Loaf Cakes
subSections.description: Whole un-iced loaf cakes, citrus bundt cakes, and spiced tea cakes suitable for family afternoon teas and casual entertaining.

itemOptions.label: Custom Inscription Message (e.g., Happy Birthday Sarah!)

choices.label: Gold Metallic Number Candles (Specify in notes)

sections.name: Cookies Biscuits & Dry Sweets
sections.description: Shelf-stable baked cookies, buttery sablés, fudge brownies, traybake bars, and twice-baked biscotti. These dry sweets have extended ambient shelf lives, serving as impulse additions at checkout, coffee companions, and packaged retail gifts.

subSections.name: Chunky & Soft-Baked Cookies
subSections.description: Thick gourmet cookies with soft molten centers, chocolate chunks, toasted nuts, and stuffed fillings.

subSections.name: Sablés Shortbreads & Crispy Biscuits
subSections.description: Rich butter sablés, traditional Scottish shortbread fingers, and delicate crispy spiced biscuits.

subSections.name: Brownies Blondies & Traybake Squares
subSections.description: Fudgy Belgian dark chocolate brownies, salted caramel blondies, and portioned traybake squares.

subSections.name: Biscotti & Dipping Cookies
subSections.description: Twice-baked almond cantucci and crunchy Italian biscotti designed specifically for dipping into coffee or dessert wine.

sections.name: Savory Bakes
sections.description: Freshly baked savory pastries, whole and sliced quiches, focaccia flatbreads, and pre-made artisan sandwiches. Provides substantial lunch and snack offerings using bakery doughs without requiring a commercial hot grill line or short-order cooks.

subSections.name: Savory Pastries & Rolls
subSections.description: Flaky puff pastry sausage rolls, spinach and feta swirls, ham and Gruyère croissants, and savory twists.

subSections.name: Quiches & Savory Tarts
subSections.description: Deep-dish Quiche Lorraine and seasonal vegetable tarts baked with velvety egg custard in crisp buttery pastry.

subSections.name: Focaccias & Savory Flatbreads
subSections.description: Extra virgin olive oil dimpled focaccia slabs, rosemary sea salt flatbreads, and tomato-olive focaccia squares.

subSections.name: Pre-made Bakery Sandwiches
subSections.description: Cold grab-and-go artisan sandwiches assembled fresh daily on house-baked baguettes, focaccia, and sourdough.

choices.label: Cold to-go (Eat cold or reheat at home)

sections.name: Confectionery & Retail
sections.description: Artisan retail pantry goods, boxed chocolates, small-batch house spreads, gift hampers, and cake celebration accessories. Generates high-margin retail revenue and customer gifting solutions requiring zero on-the-spot kitchen assembly.

subSections.name: Artisan Chocolates & Bonbon Boxes
subSections.description: Boxed selections of hand-crafted chocolate bonbons, single-origin bean-to-bar chocolate, and cocoa truffles in luxury packaging.

subSections.name: House-made Jams Curds & Spreads
subSections.description: Glass jars of small-batch seasonal berry jams, citrus curds, and artisan hazelnut chocolate spreads.

subSections.name: Gift Hampers & Assortment Boxes
subSections.description: Curated retail gift hampers combining packaged biscuits, specialty teas, jams, and bakery confections.

subSections.name: Party Accessories
subSections.description: Celebration essentials including decorative cake candles, designer greeting cards, cake knives, and carriers.

itemOptions.label: Include Complimentary Gift Bag & Handwritten Note Card

sections.name: Basic Beverages
sections.description: Essential hot coffees, loose-leaf teas, and chilled bottled beverages designed to complement baked goods. Structured for speed of service and minimal barista workload, avoiding complex drink workflows that would bottleneck the bakery retail counter.

subSections.name: Basic Hot Drinks
subSections.description: Batch-brewed drip filter coffee, Americano, hot chocolate, spiced chai, and steeped artisan loose-leaf teas.

subSections.name: Chilled Grab-and-Go Drinks
subSections.description: Bottled cold brew coffee, freshly squeezed citrus juices, sparkling mineral waters, and craft sodas.

sections.name: Seasonal & Limited Editions
sections.description: Dynamic seasonal specialties, holiday festival items, and limited guest collaborations. Allows bakeries to introduce seasonal favorites (such as King Cake, Easter Hot Cross Buns, Autumn Pumpkin Brioche, and Holiday Stollen or Panettone) without altering permanent sections.

choices.label: Festive Seasonal Gift Box with Ribbon

systemFeatures.name: Advance Pre-Order
systemFeatures.description: Enables customers to schedule advance pickup orders for whole celebration cakes, large bread orders, and party pastry boxes with configurable lead times and daily cutoff windows.

systemFeatures.name: Bake Batch Time Windows
systemFeatures.description: Displays availability and fresh-out-of-the-oven release times for daily morning and afternoon bakery bake cycles.

systemFeatures.name: Inventory & Case Badges
systemFeatures.description: Shows real-time display case availability badges, specifically 'Sold Out for Today' when daily production batches run out, without unlisting the item.

systemFeatures.name: Allergen & Dietary Tagging
systemFeatures.description: Highlights common bakery allergens (gluten, tree nuts, peanuts, dairy, eggs, soy) and dietary preferences (vegan, vegetarian) clearly on each product.

systemFeatures.name: Storage & Freshness Instructions
systemFeatures.description: Provides customers with specific storage guidance on item pages and digital receipts (e.g., store at room temperature, refrigerate below 4°C, freeze-friendly, consume day of purchase).

systemFeatures.name: Custom Cake Inscription
systemFeatures.description: Enables customers to submit personalized piped chocolate plaque or cake surface messages for celebration and whole cakes.
